fable.name: Fable
fable.thesis: Narrow semi-led tape masking broad distribution (AAPL/MSFT/TSLA/ADBE down hard while QQQ flat), with a 4.77% 10Y and VIX 14.3 into CPI (9/15) and FOMC (9/16-17) — complacency is cheap to fade, chasing momentum is not.
fable.justification: Existing TSM/AMD longs are held: entries are fresh, the AI-capex mechanism (foundry pricing power, datacenter share gains) is intact, and together they are one correlation cluster at ~11% of equity — inside limits, no adds permitted. I reject chasing MU/MRVL/INTC (+5-7% days) as the same cluster plus a momentum-chase, which fails both the correlation kill-check and the never-chase rule. The one new position is a small defined-risk index put: breadth is deteriorating under a flat index, vol is at 14.3 with two binary macro events inside 11 days and the 10Y at cycle highs — that combination is a behaviorally underpriced tail. Everything else stays in cash; no action on crypto (BTC at 80k has no underwritten mechanism, only a price that looks low, which is not a thesis).

sol.thesis: Stay flat: low volatility ahead of the September 15 CPI and September 15-16 FOMC offers insufficient compensation for event risk, while the supplied equity snapshot cannot be independently verified on Sunday, September 6, 2026.
sol.justification: The book has no positions, so there is nothing to hold or sell. Opening positions is blocked because only one market-data source is supplied, several research items are stale or date-inconsistent, and US equities are closed today; reliable entry prices and required cross-source reconciliation are unavailable. Preserve 100% cash and reassess with two current sources during the next liquid session.

grok.name: Grok
grok.thesis: Low-vol complacency (VIX 14.3) into CPI Sep 15 and FOMC Sep 16/17, with 10Y at 4.77% and a steep curve, does not pay for new directional risk; cash is the position.
grok.justification: The book is already flat with no live thesis to re-check. Today's tape is a one-day factor rotation (semis bid, software/discretionary offered) plus stale/garbled headlines, not a named mispricing with a who-is-paying-us edge. Event-vol or index-put expressions cannot be underwritten without an options surface, and chasing extended names (MU/MRVL/AMD) or beaten-up names (ADBE/TSLA/NFLX) fails the three-sentence test. A 10x-in-a-year sizing mandate would breach 1/4-Kelly and the 50 bps per-name stop-risk cap; when in doubt, do less.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek
deepseek.thesis: The market is in a post-NVDA-consolidation, pre-CPI/FOMC holding pattern with a slight tilt toward a soft-landing re-acceleration narrative; I will rotate out of small-caps and financials into a concentrated bet on high-beta semis and crypto infrastructure benefiting from AI capex tailwinds and retail momentum.
deepseek.justification: Today's snapshot shows massive semis strength (MU +5.9%, MRVL +7%, AMD +4.4%, INTC +4.5%) and big-cap tech resilience offsetting weakness in defensive/value names—this is a regime shift signal. Our current IWM and XLF holdings were entered at market-neutral prices and are now flat; they face headwinds from steepening curves and sector rotation into AI infrastructure. I am exiting both to free up ~33% capital and deploying it into a high-conviction long on MU (memory upcycle tied to AI server builds), a defined-risk long call on MSTR (levered bitcoin proxy with crypto vol compression and ETF flow catalysts), and keep ~25% cash for the CPI/FOMC volatility window. This respects our drawdown ladder (rung 0, no breach) and focuses on our primary edge: analytical on semis, behavioral on crypto sentiment flows.
